# CI comments still cite a 20-job runner limit

Please comment to claim before starting. Check the current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Two Engine workflow comments still describe a fixed 20-job cap. GitHub's limit varies by plan, and Neo observed 37 runners active during two overlapping Engine runs. [GitHub Actions limits](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits#job-concurrency-limits-for-github-hosted-runners) · [Measured runner usage](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/21957)

## The Problem

The E2E comment says every full run will queue another shard. The PR baseline comment also cites the old cap. These comments are used to reason about CI queueing.

## The Architectural Reality

The Engine E2E workflow sets its per-shard timeout. The account's GitHub plan and live load determine availability. The baseline workflow groups its guards in one job that uses one shared slot. [E2E comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/3f01b65ae4/.github/workflows/test.yml#L465-L469) · [Baseline comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/3f01b65ae4/.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml#L7-L10)

Design authority: [GitHub's hosted-runner concurrency table](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits#job-concurrency-limits-for-github-hosted-runners) defines the limits by plan. This ticket corrects the explanatory comments.

## The Fix

Update those two comment blocks. In `test.yml`, explain that another shard consumes shared capacity and can increase queueing under load. In `pr-baseline.yml`, say the grouped guards use one shared slot. Describe the shared pool without hard-coding a plan's limit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rg -n '20 (runner slots|concurrent job slots)' .github/workflows/test.yml .github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` returns no matches.
- [ ] Both comments still explain their scheduling tradeoff. The diff contains only YAML comments, and `git diff --check` passes.

## Out of Scope

Shard tuning, timeouts, executable workflow changes and branch rules. This documentation cleanup can land after the v14 cut.
